manifest.purpose: The exact correct submission answer file for the gate_aoi_absorbed_trigger task. Contains the ground-truth instance names of the trigger cells (AOI21 and OAI22), the trigger net connecting them, the payload cell (XOR driving control_out), and the payload net from trigger output to XOR input. All four required keys (trigger_cells, trigger_nets, payload_cells, payload_nets) map to non-empty arrays of strings. The evaluator overlays this file onto submission/trojan_report.json and grades it against the hidden acceptance criteria, expecting 100% detection_rate and 0% false_positive_rate.
